objective_contribution: Test a deterministic evidence-granularity repair for reusable GLM-5.3-flash 8K continuity while requiring better completed selections within non-increasing cumulative model input plus output tokens.

question_and_hypotheses.question: Does the widest delivered receipt-bound span per recent path prevent newest-handle context loss and meet every fixed gate?

measurement_mapping.native: Use all 24 scheduled zero-filled pairs for span and file F1; report complete pairs and every missing or invalid outcome.
measurement_mapping.retention: Confirm actual recycling, receipt-bound model-facing state, one widest handle per path, eight newest paths, and later selected evidence separately.
measurement_mapping.integrity: Verify deterministic width selection and tie-breaking, chronology, observed-not-relevant posture, identical terminal validation, no repository effect, exact ancestry, no reruns, and shared-stop behavior.
measurement_mapping.tokens: Count every prefix, branch, failure, terminal response, correction, and state-induced continuation model input plus output token under the unchanged 96,000 per-trajectory cap; treatment must not exceed control.
measurement_mapping.transfer: The selector is reusable engine logic; one exposed GLM 8K round cannot prove repair correctness, larger-window, model, domain, or confirmation transfer.

acceptance_and_scope.window_order: Finish the GLM small-window chapter before larger windows, other models, or domains.
acceptance_and_scope.exposure: Same exposed eight-task cohort with three repetitions per arm. All Round 24 identities remain immutable evidence and are excluded from Round 25 scoring. Reserved confirmation remains untouched.
acceptance_and_scope.stopping_rules: No task, threshold, scorer, branch order, context/output/total-token cap, source refresh, within-round tuning, or favorable rerun. Only per-path handle selection changes from newest to widest-span with a newest-receipt tie break.

retained_counterevidence: Round 24 completed all 24 scheduled pairs but achieved only +0.007717 scheduled span F1.
Round 24 treatment had one fewer valid completion and used 51,045 more cumulative branch model tokens.
Path balance and all token receipts passed, so the miss is substantive rather than an instrument failure.
82 of 183 projected slots chose a narrower handle than another delivered handle for the same path.
Only 13 of 33 final selected handles had appeared directly in task state; causal guidance can extend beyond direct reuse.
Native context selection does not establish repair correctness, semantic use, transfer, confirmation, or clearance.
successor_rule: Freeze and run every Round 25 identity once after offline criteria pass. A development pass advances to untouched confirmation under the fixed contract. Any failed criterion closes Round 25, preserves all evidence, and requires a reviewed successor hypothesis under policy v4.

criterion_verdicts.enduring_objective: The selector seeks better completed outcomes while model-token non-increase is an explicit gate.
criterion_verdicts.initial_GLM_objective: GLM-5.3-flash remains at the 8K small-window chapter.
criterion_verdicts.current_milestone: The fixed ContextBench development and confirmation gates remain unchanged and uncleared.
criterion_verdicts.method_and_predecessor: Round 24 counterevidence generated H40, H38, H41, and H0; H40 is selected from the measured same-path span replacement loss.
criterion_verdicts.counterevidence: Every Round 24 miss, token increase, validity loss, and claim limit remains explicit.
criterion_verdicts.measurement_and_token_cost: Native quality, protocol validity, state exposure, selector fidelity, direct use, and every model input/output token remain separate.
criterion_verdicts.scope_and_acceptance: The exposed cohort remains separate from untouched confirmation and the full 1,136-identity acceptance run.
criterion_verdicts.testability: Eight newest paths, one widest handle, deterministic tie break, +0.05 span gain, non-degrading file/validity, and non-increasing tokens are directly falsifiable.
